datasets.title: Surface temperature anomaly · published latitude bands
datasets.productVersion: NASA GISS GISTEMP v4 · Land–Ocean Temperature Index · zonal annual means

source.name: NASA GISS
source.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies.

datasets.snapshotNote: Table inputs: GHCN-v4 1880-10/2026 + SST: ERSST v5 1880-10/2026
datasets.aggregation: Published by NASA GISS as annual band means (land and ocean). Used as published; divided by 100 to °C.
transformations: Rows restricted to the analysis window
datasets.marks: Each point is one published annual band mean.
capabilityNotes: Only NASA's published latitude bands can be selected; custom boxes need the gridded dataset.
Annual-only source: the year × month surface is unavailable.
The map shows the GISTEMP 2° grid as context; band values come from the published table and can differ slightly from grid averages.

datasets.title: Surface temperature anomaly · 2° grid
datasets.productVersion: NASA GISS GISTEMP v4 · Land–Ocean Temperature Index · 2° grid, 1200 km smoothing

source.name: NASA GISS
source.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies.

datasets.snapshotNote: Created 2026-11-10 08:55:39 by SBBX_to_nc 2.0 - ILAND=1200, IOCEAN=NCDC/ER5, Base: 1951-1980
datasets.aggregation: Area-weighted mean of grid cells overlapping the box (fractional overlap, spherical cell area), using only cells valid in every month of the window. Annual value = calendar-day-weighted mean of 12 complete months.
transformations: int16 × 0.01 scale factor decoded; fill value 32767 kept as missing
Stored unit K anomaly, numerically equal to °C anomaly
datasets.marks: Map cells are 2° grid values drawn without interpolation; chart points are regional annual means.
capabilityNotes: NASA applies 1200 km smoothing upstream, so neighbouring cells are not independent.
Trend map shows fitted slope magnitude only; it carries no per-cell significance.

datasets.title: Precipitation · annual total · Giovanni regional means
datasets.productVersion: NASA Giovanni · GPM IMERG Final Run Monthly V07 (GPM_3IMERGM) · precipitation · regional mean
datasets.resolution: Regional mean of a 0.1° product, monthly

source.name: NASA GES DISC / Giovanni
source.citation: Huffman, G.J., E.F. Stocker, D.T. Bolvin, E.J. Nelkin, J. Tan (2023), GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07, GES DISC, doi:10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07

datasets.snapshotNote: Original Giovanni CSV exports kept in data/giovanni/.
datasets.aggregation: Area average computed by NASA Giovanni over the box. Monthly mean rate (mm/hr) × hours in the month = monthly total (mm); annual total = sum of 12 complete months.
transformations: mm/hr × hours in calendar month → mm per month
Sum of 12 complete months → mm per year
datasets.marks: Each point is one annual total for the whole box.
capabilityNotes: Regional export: only the two exported boxes can be analysed; no gridded map layer or custom boxes.
